obligations.title: Two distinct Microsoft accounts enter the same installed Team with their own authority
obligations.detail: Original UI F02 and independent rereads identify two distinct Microsoft principals in the same Team. Canonical destinations (capabilityId/surface/page/canRead/allowedActionIds) must differ and each actor must retain its own owner/projection after reload. Identity, revisions, availability and ordering alone cannot satisfy the oracle. No role, ACL or configuration is created by this case.

obligations.title: An explicit A B A Team switch leaves the sibling window on its own Team
obligations.detail: Original action F02 A/B/A, exact canonical URLs, sibling A unchanged after reload, and the original before/after grant fingerprint equality. Equality of empty arrays is not proof of distinct grants.

obligations.title: An authenticated account without Team access cannot open the original business chapter
obligations.detail: Requires the authenticated no-teams/revoked projection from integrated295eb: identify the original denied principal, preserve absent business owner/data, and observe the original Team business route403.

obligations.title: A foreign installation deep link and reload cannot inherit the current Team selection
obligations.detail: Requires #654 integrated: original valid deep link/reload; foreign installation rejected as invalid before a Team context request; selection/links absent; no fallback.

obligations.title: A Microsoft configuration administrator without Teams cannot acquire business access
obligations.detail: The original administrator without Teams opens the actual root administration toggle; its UI GET catalog and ready controls agree with an independent original read. No Chat/dashboard is available and explicit Team business remains 403.

obligations.title: Keyboard navigation opens a new Team chat draft on narrow Web without changing owner
obligations.detail: At 390x844, keyboard Enter opens the actual new Chat with exactly five versioned owner-query fields. Original F02/list/SSE, canonical namespace and editable empty composer retain the same owner; the whole scenario observes zero POST. New inside the ready workspace is local and does not invent another F02.

obligations.title: A Team switch keeps a canceled chat draft and discards it only on confirmation
obligations.detail: The actual native dialog keeps A and its unsent text on cancel; confirmation changes to B with a ready but empty composer. Returning to A rereads F02/list/SSE and cannot resurrect the discarded text. Original response namespaces remain bound and no POST is sent.

obligations.title: Real administration revokes a disposable Team and restores its original configuration
obligations.detail: Original administrator uses one disable and, when the original reread proves it necessary, one enable with the exact opaque CAS tokens. Catalog, F02 revocation/business403 for both actors, unaffected B and restored admission remain required. Canonical shared documents for A/B are read before and after and must be identical; the global revision is never rewound.

obligations.title: Logout invalidates the original Microsoft browser context and preserves the other account
obligations.detail: Original UI POST 204, original F02 unauthenticated 401 and stale-window reload, with the holder's owner and original grant fingerprint preserved. Empty fingerprint equality is not distinct-grant proof. Raw token replay/global sign-out/restart remain separate AZ02 obligations.
